messages:
talia: Quick sync: CloudAtlas (partner) wants a small joint push: marketplace listing + micro-benchmark blog + a 45-min webinar. Goal: drive trial signups routed to partner ops. Need owners + minimal checklist.

raj: I can own the marketplace listing and approvals. Ask CloudAtlas for logo pack, short blurb, and partner contact. What hero metric do we want to surface?

noah: Ill do the micro-benchmark. Propose we show: 4k context p95 < 100ms, cost per 1k tokens delta vs baseline, and a 2-paragraph methodology note. Keep charts simple (bar + small table).

sophie: Ill handle webinar ops and landing page. Prefer Wed Jun 10 or Thu Jun 11. Need speaker names by EOD Mon so we can lock the calendar. Also recommend 2 email pushes + organic LinkedIn.

karen: For leads, recommend tagging lead.partner=cloudatlas and lead.source=marketplace_webinar. Routing: marketplace -> partner-ops queue for 48h qualification -> SDR if qualified. We should include partner tag as a hidden field on the registration form.

raj: CloudAtlas legal asked for co-brand guidelines. Ill request the assets and their approved messaging lines. Also will draft the listing copy and share for review.

noah: Benchmark plan: run 4k streaming at batch sizes 1 and 4, capture median/p95 and token cost. Will put raw run links in the doc and call out any variance. ETA Thu EOD.

sophie: Promo plan: announce email + reminder, 2 LinkedIn posts, and ask CloudAtlas to amplify. Paid budget ask: $800. Ill build the registration page with hidden partner fields and GA tracking. Retarget window = 21d.

karen: Minimal JSON for Eng/SFDC team to implement: ```json { "partner": "cloudatlas", "origin": "marketplace_webinar", "route": "partner-ops", "qual_hours": "48" } ``` Map Partner_Tag__c <- partner; Lead_Origin__c <- origin; AssignmentRule -> partner-ops.

talia: Owners recap:
- Marketplace listing: raj
- Micro-benchmark blog + visuals: noah
- Webinar ops + landing: sophie
- Lead tagging & routing rules: karen
- Launch social + short post: talia

partnerships-bot: Reminder: request co-brand assets from CloudAtlas by 2026-06-01 10:00 PT.

noah: Uploaded draft bench figures. 8k runs noisier; recommending headline with 4k and appendix for 8k. Added methodology and raw run links.

sophie: CloudAtlas PM confirmed Jun 10 morning PT. Locking webinar for 2026-06-10 9am PT. Ill create invite and registration page.

raj: Draft listing pushed to the shared doc. Talia, please review copy and tone before I send to CloudAtlas for signoff.

talia: Reviewing now. Please update the tracker with ETA for blocked items (legal, assets). If anything slips, we escalate to Partnerships. Thanks team! :rocket:
